name: abandoned survey equipment
description: Abandoned measuring instruments and a stained cup crowd the leader's table. A field journal is pinned beneath a weight.

name: defaced memorial
description: Names have been scraped from an old memorial behind the altar. Black wax fills the cuts, but the earlier promise of shelter can still be read.

name: dragged remains
description: Drag marks lead from the stripped camp into the sunken hollow. The creature has dragged its victims behind the broken stone screens. The supply bundle lies off the main approach.

name: fractured boundary stone
description: The ruined foundation has split around a living fissure. Ash covers the approach, but the central wound is still open. Sealing it will suppress new manifestations nearby, not remove creatures already here.

name: Black Dogs trophy rack
description: Broken shields, shackles and stolen clothing hang beside the training yard. Human soldiers left ration lists and rough bedding; the guards remaining here are warped followers. The prisoners scratched a way through tied cage doors. Beyond the timber screens lies the leader's fighting ground.

name: discarded playthings
description: Tiny shoes and torn playthings lie under the flowers. The games end where the silk begins. Dry shells lie split and empty; swelling cocoons may open after your approach. Their occupants cannot be turned back into people.

name: Flora's work journal
description: Notes on herbs and protective marks lie beside unfinished repairs. The west road and southern garden are kept clear so visitors can come and go without disturbing the beds.

name: charred siege standard
description: The standard survived a siege that melted its fittings. Broken ramparts offer cover on the approach. Inside the crucible, leave the marked breath line during preparation; the dragon cannot turn the shot after aiming.
